typeReference.signature: client.Evals.Runs.OutputItems.List(evalId, runId, after, limit, status, order) -> Task<CursorPage<EvalRunOutputItem>>

fields.name: after
fields.description: Identifier for the last output item from the previous pagination request.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Number of output items to retrieve.

fields.name: status
fields.description:
Filter output items by status. Use `failed` to filter by failed output
items or `pass` to filter by passed output items.

fields.name: order
fields.description: Sort order for output items by timestamp. Use `asc` for ascending order or `desc` for descending order. Defaults to `asc`.

fields.name: Object
fields.description: The type of the object. Always "eval.run.output_item".

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the evaluation run output item.

fields.name: RunId
fields.description: The identifier of the evaluation run associated with this output item.

fields.name: EvalId
fields.description: The identifier of the evaluation group.

fields.name: CreatedAt
fields.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the evaluation run was created.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: The status of the evaluation run.

fields.name: DatasourceItemId
fields.description: The identifier for the data source item.

fields.name: DatasourceItem
fields.description: Details of the input data source item.

fields.name: Results
fields.description: A list of grader results for this output item.

fields.name: Sample
fields.description: A sample containing the input and output of the evaluation run.
